day_shape: 91 items: IRGC says a supertanker carrying 2m+ barrels hit a mine south of Hormuz, Pakistan army chief Munir in Tehran as Iran-Pakistan border reopens, UK MoD announces additional military support to Saudi Arabia, Netanyahu says toppling Iran's regime is Israel's 'primary objective' after Hegseth visit.

threads.label: Hormuz tanker incident and IRGC claims
threads.summary: Iran's IRGC navy said a supertanker carrying over 2 million barrels of crude struck a sea mine south of the Strait of Hormuz after ignoring warnings, with Defa Press and IRIB posting video and claims of expanded Iranian maritime surveillance to Ras al-Hadd. The UK Maritime Trade Operations reported a tanker-and-military incident around 121nm east of Duqm, Oman, and Jerusalem Post cited IRGC claims that two tankers were hit.

threads.label: Pakistan army chief visits Tehran
threads.summary: Pakistan's army chief Field Marshal Asim Munir arrived in Tehran and met President Pezeshkian, Speaker Ghalibaf and SNSC secretary Rezaei, with Munir announcing the Iran-Pakistan border reopened Tuesday morning after days of closure. Iranian readouts quoted Pezeshkian blaming US 'warmongering' for Hormuz disruption and Rezaei saying no enriched nuclear material would leave Iran.

threads.label: US posture and Netanyahu regime-change line
threads.summary: Netanyahu said toppling Iran's regime was Israel's 'primary objective' and confirmed discussing it with Trump, as Jerusalem Post reported the Pentagon is sending the USS Theodore Roosevelt strike group and a Marine unit to the Middle East and that the administration came 'very close' to approving a strike. Iranian officials told Reuters they were prolonging US talks to weaken Trump before midterms.

threads.label: UK military support to Saudi Arabia
threads.summary: The UK Ministry of Defence announced additional defensive military support to Saudi Arabia citing escalating Houthi attacks, with Jerusalem Post citing Bloomberg that the RAF is expected to fly missions defending Saudi cities and infrastructure. Separately, Turkey submitted a trilateral defence pact with Pakistan and Saudi Arabia to parliament for ratification.

threads.label: IDF Gaza strikes on Hamas figures
threads.summary: The IDF and Shin Bet said they killed Akram Bassam Shaaban Yassin, a senior official in Hamas's General Security Mechanism, in a Gaza City strike, and separately killed Tamer Mohammad Ibrahim al-Zabaq, named as the final member of the Hamas cell that abducted Shani Louk on October 7. The Hamas-run Gaza Health Ministry said IDF strikes killed four people in Gaza.

threads.label: Lebanon front and Hezbollah weapons
threads.summary: The IDF said troops dismantled 540+ terrorist infrastructure sites and seized 150+ weapons in southern Lebanon operations around Al-Khiam, Tayr Harfa, Meiss El Jabal and Majdal Zoun, and released video it says shows Hezbollah still transporting weapons the Lebanese Army claimed to have seized. Israeli and Lebanese officials met at US CENTCOM headquarters in Tampa, per two IDF sources cited by Jerusalem Post.

threads.label: Iranian military messaging on drones and jets
threads.summary: Armed forces chief Maj. Gen. Abdollahi, touring army drone production lines, said any 'enemy' mistake would meet a heavier response, and Defa Press reported his confirmation that a heavy Iranian fighter jet will take off next year. IRIB and Defa Press posted claims that Iran had downed 54 MQ-9 Reapers, while Pezeshkian appointed Sardar Ibn al-Reza as presidential defence adviser.

events.title: Two Palestinian suspects who attempted to "sabotage operational infrastructure" in the Gaza Strip yesterday were targeted in a drone strike, the military says. The pair had crossed the "Yellow Line" and tried to steal pipes used by the military as part of its tunnel-detection project. The IDF says that after the pair were identified as "posing an immediate threat," they were struck. The military says "hits were identified," without confirming whether they were killed.

Footage shows Hezbollah operatives loading weapons onto a truck in an attempt to remove them from the site and preserve them.
